name: @cas/exact
description: Exact-arithmetic kernel shared across the suite: ℚ and ℚ(i) over BigInt, and exact univariate polynomials over ℚ(i) (division, evaluation, rendering). The exact analogue of @cas/core's numeric kernel — the shared home for the exact-poly primitives the sibling apps need (correspondences' curves, CD's dynatomic/Gleason/multiplier). Convention-neutral (ADR-0006).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
